body: As the low hum grows louder, a wave of dread washes over me. My heart pounds in my chest as I feel a mix of anger and compassion surge within me. The feeling of protecting myself from whatever may be causing this disturbance intensifies. But there’s also a deep wellspring of care for anyone who might be affected by this intrusion into our space. I close my eyes and take a deep breath, trying to calm both my own turmoil and any potential panic that could lead me astray.
